title: Early Estimation of Language to Latent Alignment in Diffusion Models
role: The noise-aware text and image model this loop tests as a sentence-score checker
reads: Noisy SDXL latent passed through a fixed 4-to-3 linear map to RGB, then a fine-tuned CLIP ViT-L/14 image encoder; frozen CLIP text encoder; no timestep input
trained_on: 50,000 SDXL latents from steps 20-29 of 50 with rewritten CC12M captions, InfoNCE with in-batch negatives, image encoder tuned, 10 epochs
score_enters: No gradient enters a sampler; the dot-product score ranks seeds mid-generation so weak seeds stop early (Best-of-N)
properties: Prompt match by Recall@1; counting, attribute and spatial only as GenAI-Bench image-ranking skills; no binding or relation swap test; position and size not measured separately
unseen: no: no concept hold-out; the SDXL-trained model is run zero-shot on SD3.5 and FLUX.1
headline: Recall@1 for the right caption among 5 (0 to 1, higher is better, chance 0.20) over latents 21-30: 0.506 NoisyCLIP against 0.145 frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 on SDXL; at 150 of 300 Best-of-6 steps its VQAScore is 2% below 300-step CLIP
copy_or_avoid: Copy the frozen text tower and linear latent map rewritten without the 8-bit step; avoid expecting steps 0-9 to work, since the right caption ranks first below chance there and no swap-word pair or gradient was tested (inferred)
model: SDXL (zero-shot tests on SD3.5 and FLUX.1)
